description: Canonical source template for 17 architecture gates and 13 PostgreSQL gates. Runtime evidence is generated per exact workflow run and commit SHA; this file contains no PASS decisions.

architecture_criteria.required_evidence: Dated runtime, store, table, reader/writer, entrypoint and adapter-boundary inventory bound to exact SHA.
Duplicate-authority and error inventory with disposition evidence for every finding.
PostgreSQL reconciliation report with zero unexplained mismatches, tied to exact run and SHA.
Evidence that canonical Ledger, Escrow, Witness and Outbox remain authoritative and legacy paths fail closed.
Lifecycle, value conservation, idempotency, replay/conflict, rollback and transaction-boundary evidence.
Evidence that cross-component operations use approved adapters and reject bypasses.
G3 TRUST, TRANSPARENCY and PERFORMANCE/TRIUMPH governance evidence, including negative cases.
Real PostgreSQL atomicity, concurrency, rollback, replay and no-duplicate-movement evidence.
Interrupted-transaction and restart recovery evidence with no duplicate value movement.
Movement-to-escrow, witness, outbox, idempotency and integrity evidence.
Organizational IAM/MFA and privileged-access review evidence; source tests alone are insufficient.
Readiness/liveness, structured logs, metrics, alerts and failure-mode evidence.
Repeatable production-like workload, concurrency/load profile, thresholds and retained results.
Backup/restore drill, recovery objectives and post-restore integrity reconciliation.
Exact-SHA required checks, branch governance, release approval and review evidence.
Attributed independent reproduction of migration, lifecycle, reconciliation and recovery.
Manifest, run IDs, exact SHA, logs, migration checksums, decision and retained artifacts.

postgres_checks.required_evidence: Compile production, persistence, services, CORE and PostgreSQL source on exact SHA.
Complete CORE foundation regression suite and retained JUnit result.
Successful connection to the isolated PostgreSQL instance and recorded server identity.
Atomic migration application and checksum rollback/publication evidence.
Supported legacy schema upgrade and data-preservation evidence.
Canonical PostgreSQL escrow lifecycle re-performance evidence.
Concurrent migration runner and no-duplicate-publication evidence.
Duplicate publication and checksum fail-closed evidence.
Production runtime boot and canonical schema validation evidence.
Actual PostgreSQL migration catalog, 18-version history and checksum evidence.
Exact-SHA migration manifest, applied rows and checksum index evidence.

migration_registry.note: Migration 018 is included in the repair candidate; the 18-version chain remains unverified until exact-SHA PostgreSQL migration and lifecycle evidence is captured.
